notes.title: Patch July 11th
notes.notes:
Fixed bug with missing cursor on Mac
Added icon for quick access to summer splash

notes.title: Sippy's Summer Splash
notes.notes:
Jump into summer! Join Sippy on 30 additional summer themed levels. You can now jump to a distant tile using triangle tiles!

In addition, I've been listening to your feedback. I've added a move goal visible on every level so it's easy to know what score you need to hit to get 100%.

Play today!

notes.title: Sippy May Patch
notes.notes:
[list]

notes.title: Sippy's Spring Fling Launch!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843251/db72e2e57a330f9a78e7fe1ac41d59a5fce1502a.png[/img]

In addition, I fixed a bug where sippy would keep walking if you changed levels while moving.

notes.notes:

Fixed reset when level complete

notes.title: Patch 1 - Quality of Life
notes.notes:
I heard your feedback and am listening!
This patch has a lot of quality of life features including:
[list]
[*]Menu button in game is now on the right close to where the menu opens
[*]Added a reset level button
[*]Added a level select button in the pause menu
[*]The game now checks for a perfect score after every level completion
[/list]
Be on the lookout for more exciting features coming up soon!

notes.title: March 4th Update
notes.notes:
What an exciting launch! This is a quick build with some urgent bugfixes.
I am listening to the feedback and will add some quality of life features soon including a level restart button and a level select option in the menu.
Thank you everyone for the support!

notes.title: Sippy Disco Hits like a Burst of Confetti!
notes.notes:
Hey there, party people!
Joel Page here, and I'm about to drop some seriously groovy news! Tomorrow, brace yourselves as my latest creation, Sippy Disco, hits Steam like a burst of confetti!
Picture this: You're about to embark on a neon-fueled puzzle adventure that'll have you tapping your toes and moving to the beat! Meet Sippy the unicorn, the ultimate dance floor diva, on a mission to light up every square with style and finesse. But hold onto your glittery hats, because Sippy's not alone – join forces with roller-skating parrots and disco balls to really amp up the fun!
Now, let me take you back to where it all began. My partner-in-crime and I, fueled by caffeine and dreams, decided to sprinkle a little magic into the world with our business, Sippy Crumbs. We're all about spreading joy, one cup of coffee, cookie, and heartfelt card at a time. But amidst our hustle, I found myself knee-deep in the development of a complex RPG game. Don't get me wrong, I was passionate, but the road ahead seemed endless. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843251/f4d024e35f3eeeb7c744505364985405c4af9aed.png[/img]
Then, in a stroke of pure inspiration, I hit the reset button. What if I infused our company's mascot, the beloved unicorn Sippy, into a new gaming venture? And just like that, Sippy Disco was born! With a few swift moves and some coding magic, I had a prototype ready to dazzle the world.
Fast forward to today, and Sippy Disco isn't just a game – it's a vibe! We've been setting up shop at local markets, inviting folks to boogie down with Sippy while they browse. It's been an incredible journey watching players light up with excitement as they conquer each level. Much like Sippy Crumbs, our game is all about forging connections and uplifting spirits with every pixelated step.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843251/6b28de269e897aaa270db71ecb6f78e2003a1851.gif[/img]
Ready to join the party? Sippy Disco is hitting Steam at a sweet 15% off, so mark your calendars for March 1st! And if you're in the mood for some real-life fun, catch Sippy strutting his stuff at the Phoenix Melrose Street Fair this weekend!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843251/35ba61f04b7a4b5baa085eeaf00e15c1ed2d12a7.gif[/img]
So, what are you waiting for? Let's dance our way to victory with Sippy Disco!

notes.title: Get Ready to Groove!
notes.notes:
It's been an adventure getting ready to launch my first game on Steam! I'm excited to launch Sippy this Friday! 

[b]Some exciting updates before release:[/b]
[list]
[*]Character customization options
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843251/54d12282b47dfe68c6e4035c9f761e3b03f14ab9.gif[/img]
[*]Voice acting for Sippy
[*]A new song for the credits screen
[/list]

Stay tuned for the release this Friday March 1st!

notes.title: But what you don't know about Sippy is...
notes.notes:
Hi Friends! Joel here.
Did you know Sippy Disco was inspired by Sippy Crumbs Coffee? My partner and I founded Sippy Crumbs to encourage connectivity through Coffee, Cookies, and Cards. Sippy the Unicorn is our mascot and having Sippy Disco available to play at the markets is a fun way for our visitors to pass some time and maybe get a high score!

[url=https://www.sippycrumbs.com/visit-us]Find out where we will be with our event calendar![/url]
